hook.name: UmiaHook
hook.description: Singleton Uniswap v4 hook for Umia LBP (Liquidity Bootstrapping Pool) pools. Enforces full-range-only liquidity positions, maintains a TWAP oracle (ring-buffer observations written before each swap and liquidity event), and deducts a configurable protocol fee from each swap's output side via afterSwapReturnsDelta, crediting it to a per-pool fee recipient.
